 Coram: Honourable The Chief Justice

 Honourable Mr. Justice Partha Sarthy
Oral Order

(Per: HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE)
5 19-01-2023 We are informed that the Two-Member Committee constituted by the N.H.A.I., at this point in time,
is not functional on account of resignation of the nominated members.
Let NHAI take steps for nominating new persons.
Needful be positively done within two weeks.
Affidavit dated 18.01.2023 filed by Shri Pawan Kumar, District Land Acquisition Officer, Supaul is absolutely vague and unspecific.

No reason stands assigned as to why the amount received as compensation for disbursement to the rightful claimants has yet not been released and what are the Patna High Court CWJC No.3601 of 2022(5) dt.19-01-2023 reasons for delay.
Noticeably, only 10% of the amount of Rs. 279 crores (approx.) stands released.

Shambhu Sharan Singh (Nh-227J, 227L, ... vs The Union Of India, on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150811972/
1
We are dealing with the construction of NH-227J, 527A, 327E commonly termed as "Umagaon-Saharsa (Package-I, II, III & V)".
Shri Shambhu Sharan Singh appearing in-person, points out that the total stretch of 140 Km of road was to be constructed on or before 10th January, 2023.
Noticeably, even 10% of the land has yet not been acquired.

Under these circumstances, we direct the Development Commissioner, Government of Bihar to immediately convene a meeting of all the stakeholders, including the concerned District Magistrate;
Senior Superintendent(s) of Police; District Land Acquisition Officer(s) and NHAI, and file his personal affidavit indicating steps taken and the timeline within which the entire stretch of land would be acquired; possession handed over to NHAI; amount disbursed to the rightful claimants and the reasons for non-disbursement of the same thereafter.

As already directed, special camps would be organized by the land acquisition authorities in sensitizing the Patna High Court CWJC No.3601 of 2022(5) dt.19-01-2023 claimants/land owners and enabling them to complete the formalities at the earliest.
We direct, should anyone of the claimants have objection to the receipts of amount, so determined as compensation, to receive the same under protest, to pursue their remedies in accordance with law.

Further, if anyone of the claimants refused to accept the amount of compensation, so determined under Section 3G of the National Highways Act, CALA shall deposit the same with the concerned District Judge.
The entire exercise be positively completed within the next three weeks.
We direct the Development Commissioner to convene a meeting in his chamber either through physical or digital mode on 24.01.2023.
Shri Anjani Kumar, learned A.A.G.-4, undertakes to communicate the order telephonically to all concerned.

(Sanjay Karol, CJ) ( Partha Sarthy, J) Sujit/Ashwini U Shambhu Sharan Singh (Nh-227J, 227L, ... vs The Union Of India, on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150811972/
